note: Each row: a faith, a good, what its cities pay as a multiple (0.60 - 1.35), and why. Absent means 1.00. Applied as 1 + (multiplier - 1) x faith_demand_amplitude, multiplied into port_goods.demand by world.demand_for beside 0066's region x category appetite. Per good, not per category, because coffee and wine are both Drink and Islam loved one and forbade the other. Goods a culture refuses outright stay in goods.cultureMask (0080); this file only prices what is traded.
